brief:
Alrowwad Cultural and Arts Society has concluded a three-day youth summer camp in Bethlehem centered on human rights, advocacy and media skills, the Palestine News Network reported. The program, titled "Here We Remain," brought together participants from across the occupied West Bank to engage with civic engagement strategies and journalism practices.

The camp curriculum focused on equipping young people with practical tools for advocacy work and media literacy. Participants learned techniques for amplifying their voices on human rights issues and documenting conditions in their communities. The initiative reflects Alrowwad's broader mission to develop youth capacity for cultural expression and civic participation across Palestinian territories.
